title: DMS Private Video Benchmark Inputs
subtitle: Private event-level DMS benchmark videos and pipeline code
description: Private benchmark manifest, 20 visually audited real-person Pexels videos, and the DMS evaluation code required for reproducible video-level multi-label testing. Includes handheld-phone positives, mounted/passenger phone hard negatives, seatbelt controls, rain, night, reflections, and varied camera views.
